items.name: All-Star Special®
items.description: Two eggs cooked to order with toast, jelly, your choice of grits or hashbrowns, choice of bacon, sausage, or ham, and a classic sweet cream waffle.

items.name: Two Egg Breakfast
items.description: Two Grade A eggs cooked to order, served with buttered toast and choice of grits or crispy hashbrowns.

items.name: T-Bone Steak & Eggs
items.description: USDA Choice 10-oz T-Bone steak grilled hot, paired with two eggs, buttered toast, and choice of grits or hashbrowns.

items.name: Sirloin Steak & Eggs
items.description: Tender USDA Choice Sirloin steak seared on the flat top, served with two eggs, toast, and choice of grits or hashbrowns.

items.name: Country Ham & Eggs
items.description: Thick-cut dry-cured Southern country ham paired with two eggs cooked to order, toast, and choice of grits or hashbrowns.

items.name: Pork Chop & Eggs
items.description: Two center-cut pork chops grilled golden brown, served with two eggs, buttered toast, and choice of grits or hashbrowns.

items.name: Grilled Chicken & Eggs
items.description: Juicy grilled chicken breast filet served with two eggs cooked to order, buttered toast, and choice of grits or hashbrowns.
